title.zh-Hans: 睁越迷影（穿越瓯越大陆）

description.zh-Hans: 作品构建了一个奇妙的瓯越冒险世界。主人公在瓯江、雁荡山历经重重挑战，与水鬼黑影、神秘怪物等斗智斗勇；或被困医院，穿梭于诡异走廊与神秘地下室，对抗幽灵等超自然威胁，破解三道商业谜题，激活瓯越商帮智慧，唤...
description.en: This work creates a fascinating adventure world set in Ouyue. The protagonist faces numerous challenges along the Oujiang River and Yandang Mountains, outwitting water ghosts, dark shadows, and mysterious monsters. Sometimes trapped in a hospital, they navigate eerie corridors and secret basements, confronting ghosts and other supernatural threats.
